name: Booth Graphics Design Brief – AWS re:Invent 2025 (DualBird)
notes:
We’re preparing our 10x10 booth graphics for AWS re:Invent, with a hard deadline for submission on September 26th. We want to explore different creative directions for the booth visuals so we can decide how bold or clean we want to go.

You’ll design for:
1. Back wall panels (3 sections: left, center, right)
2. Demo counter front panel
(see attached)

Creative directions to explore:

Option A – Clean & Sophisticated
• Minimal, modern, sharp
• Focus on the DualBird logo + a short headline
• Use whitespace or solid backgrounds, 1–2 visual elements max
• Could include subtle visuals
• Easy to digest in 3 seconds

Option B – Bold & Playful
• Eye-catching and different
• Cartoon-style inspiration with pipes, mountains, clouds, etc.
• Still professional, but stands out visually
• Integrate DualBird logo and headline in a way that feels part of the illustration

Notes:
• Consider the 43” monitor and cabinet placement — avoid putting key elements where they’ll be blocked (see templates)
• Must be readable and memorable from a distance
• Visuals should support the message: performance + simplicity + instant time-to-value
• First concepts: ASAP (latest by Sept 18)
• Final version ready for AWS by Sept 25

Whats The Goal of This Deliverable?
The goal is to create visually compelling booth graphics that attract foot traffic at AWS re:Invent 2025 and support our company’s positioning. The booth should stand out, be immediately understandable, and reflect the bold yet accessible personality of DualBird.

We want attendees to:
• Instantly get what we do (at least at a high level)
• Be curious enough to stop and ask questions
• Remember us after walking away

Where Would it Be Displayed?
• 10x10 Turnkey Booth Wall (3-panel back wall with lightbox section on top)
• Front of the Demo Counter
• Located in the AWS re:Invent expo hall
• Surrounded by hundreds of other tech booths — first impression matters

Whats The Target Audience?
• Technical decision-makers (CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Data/Infrastructure)
• Enterprise architects, data platform leads, and cloud engineers
• Investors and AWS ecosystem partners who might not know us yet

Most are senior professionals walking quickly through the expo, scanning for things that are:
• Visually interesting
• Relevant to their domain
• Easy to engage with

They don’t know us yet, so the graphics need to do heavy lifting up front.

Things to Avoid?
• No birds (even though our name is DualBird)
• No cityscapes or skyline visuals
• Don’t clutter with too much text — no paragraphs or technical details
• Avoid visuals that are too “abstract” or generic (we’re not just another cloud infra company)
• Avoid overusing AWS branding elements — we want to stand out, not blend in

Content
Placeholder for now:
Back wall headline: Accelerate Spark and Iceberg with zero code changes

Counter: Dualbirds logo
Mini tagline: Break performance limits in your data pipeline

name: Benchmark graphs
notes:
**Design Brief for Benchmark Graphs**

**Client Information:**  
- Name: Sabrina Fradkin  
- Email: sabrina@dualbird.io  
- Company: Dualbird  

**Project Title:**  
Benchmark Graphs for External and Internal Use

**Project Overview:**  
Design two visually engaging, clear, and simplified benchmark comparison graphs for Dualbird. These graphs will illustrate Dualbird’s performance and cost savings relative to Spark, serving both external presentation at conferences and potential inclusion on the company’s website. The existing benchmark graph on the current website (located under the Benchmark section) will serve as the foundation, but the new design should improve upon it—most notably, by transitioning from linear to columnar (bar/column) graphs.

**Objective / Purpose:**  
Create two clean, easily interpretable graphs that effectively compare Dualbird’s performance and cost savings against Spark. These visuals will be used by the CEO during conferences from June 1–11, to answer benchmark-related questions. There is also a potential to add these graphs to the company's website and other materials such as investor decks and sales follow-ups.

**Display Context:**  
- Primary: Conference presentations and 1:1 meetings (June 1–11)  
- Secondary: Company website (under "Benchmark" section, TBA)  
- Additional: Investor presentations and field sales follow-ups

**Target Audience:**  
- Technical decision-makers: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of Data  
- Business stakeholders: CIOs, cost-conscious buyers, procurement leads  
- Investors & analysts: seeking product differentiation and market edge  
- Industry peers: benchmarking at conferences and industry events

**Design Requirements & Constraints:**  
- The graphs should be simplified following the style of the provided example (attached).  
- Use data points from rows 209–218 of the attached Excel file for the graph values.  
- Transition the current linear graph style to columnar (bar/column) format for enhanced clarity.  
- Maintain consistency in size and technical specifications with the existing website graphs.  
- Focus on creating clear, simple visuals, avoiding overcomplication—especially since the client emphasizes simplicity for conference settings.

**Files Provided:**  
- Example graph style (attached)  
- Excel data file with relevant data points (rows 209–218)  
- Additional unspecified objects (attachments indicated as [object Object]) for further reference or assets

**Timeline & deliverables:**  
- Due date: June 3, 2025  
- Budget: 2 hours allocated (indicating quick turnaround, prioritizing efficiency)  
- Note: This is a last-minute request driven by feedback to simplify the website graph, with urgent use planned during early June. The client emphasizes simplicity and usability.

**Notes & Additional Information:**  
- The client is available via phone for questions during the task.  
- There is a scheduling question, indicating availability for a discussion prior to starting; please confirm as needed.

**Next Steps:**  
- Review the example style and data files.  
- Develop two columnar benchmark comparison graphs aligning with the provided style and data.  
- Ensure the visuals are suitable for both conference presentations and potential website use.  
- Deliver by June 3, 2025, considering the tight timeline.

**Contact for Clarification:**  
Sabrina Fradkin – sabrina@dualbird.io

---

HERO

A data acceleration engine for the AI era

AI runs on GPUs. Networks run on purpose-built silicon. Storage has ASICs. And data processing - the workload that feeds it all - has been running on general-purpose CPUs. Until now.

DualBird introduces custom, hardware and software co-designed and purpose-built for data processing, and delivers it as a simple Spark plugin on AWS F2 instances. 

No new infrastructure. No code changes. Just a fundamental shift in what's possible.

THE PROBLEM

To keep pace with AI, data processing needs a revolution

Your AI model is only as good as the data foundation it runs on.

AI has GPUs, but right now, most data pipelines rely on hardware that wasn't built for data. 

The only path to the speed and cost efficiency that modern AI workloads demand is hardware-level, domain-specific acceleration.


—-



OUR TECHNOLOGY

The DualBird Approach: Hardware and Software co-designed 

DualBird bridges the engineering divide, bringing hardware and software minds together in order to outperform general-purpose CPU pipelines and shatter the software optimization ceiling.

The result is what we wanted from the beginning: something powerful enough to fundamentally change the performance and cost trajectory of data processing workloads, and simple enough to deploy that the barrier is deciding to try it, not procuring or integrating it.



—-



DEPLOYMENT

Built to seamlessly fit into your stack

Accelerate data processing with zero code changes and zero migration effort. DualBird integrates directly into Apache Spark and your existing Spark pipelines.

    No on-premises hardware.

    Your team switches to F2 instances the way they'd switch any instance type.
Your application is untouched. Your pipelines are untouched. Your speed is 10x - 30X.

BENEFITS

Shuffle

Spark Tuning — Eliminated
The majority of Spark performance knobs become obsolete, providing predictable out-of-the-box performance
